first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, making onboarding simplification the most direct sustainable response and less dependent on discounting. Verify the prior onboarding effect and the durability of promotional-pricing revenue before ruling out a competitor-response offer. Run a guarded test measuring qualified activation, time-to-value, retention proxies, and downstream qualified pipeline rather than completion alone.

final.rationale: Run a standard, guarded onboarding-simplification experiment this week. The verified prior result directly addresses the 4% completion decline and improved time-to-value and 30-day retention, supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Do not use promotional pricing as the primary response: its verified 18% qualified-revenue lift was followed by a 12% retention decline and failed the sustainability objective. Measure completion alongside first meaningful action, qualified pipeline or revenue, and renewal/retention proxies; expand only if downstream quality improves.
